examples.en: Asked his nationality, he said American.
examples.zh: 问到他的国籍，他说是美国人。

examples.en: All applicants will be considered regardless of age, sex, religion or nationality.
examples.zh: 所有申请者，不论其年龄、性别、宗教信仰及国籍，都可考虑。

examples.en: "For us", he said, "every man and woman of French nationality is French."
examples.zh: “对我们来说，”他说，“每一个法国国籍的男人和女人都是法国人。”
